result.stdout:
cleanupdate — build the update artifacts CleanUpdate consumes. USAGE cleanupdate keygen [--out ] [--bits 3072] [--force] Generate an RSA key pair: private.xml (keep secret) + public.xml (ship in app). cleanupdate pack --input --version [options] Zip the publish folder, hash it, and emit a release entry. PACK OPTIONS --input Publish folder to package (required). --version Release version (required). --output Where to write artifacts (default: current dir). --name App name used for the zip file name (default: app). --zip-name Override the zip file name (default: -.zip). --base-url Public base URL of the artifacts; builds package.url etc. --channel Release channel (default: stable). --mandatory Mark the release mandatory. --min-version With --mandatory: only forced below this version. --changelog Inline changelog. --changelog-file

Read the changelog from a file. --key Sign the package (and feed) with this RSA key. --delta Also emit a delta manifest.json of every file. --delta-base-url Where the unpacked files are hosted (default: --base-url). --feed Create/update this feed with the release (else printed to stdout). EXAMPLE cleanupdate pack --input publish --version 2.1.0 \ --base-url https://downloads.example.com/myapp \ --key private.xml --delta --feed feed.json
